formats.key: addLiquidity(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 amountADesired,uint256 amountBDesired,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends up to amountADesired of tokenA to the pair, at least amountAMin.
The signer sends up to amountBDesired of tokenB to the pair, at least amountBMin.
The router creates the pair if it does not exist yet.
The pair mints LP tokens (UNI-V2) to `to`; the pool decides the amount.
formats.shown: Add up to X tokenA and up to Y tokenB as liquidity, with minimums, the recipient and the deadline.

findings.title: addLiquidity does not show the LP tokens received; the pool decides the amount, and no minimum exists.
findings.evidence: Case 0: UNI-V2 2961077006359078 arrives at the signer from 0x0; screen says only 'as liquidity' and 'Recipient'. UniswapV2Router02.addLiquidity: liquidity = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(to).
findings.fix: Rename the 'Recipient' label to 'LP Tokens Recipient' so the signer knows what `to` receives.

cases.notes: LP amount not shown; pool decides it.

formats.key: addLiquidityETH(address token,uint256 amountTokenDesired,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: The signer sends up to amountTokenDesired of token to the pair, at least amountTokenMin.
The signer sends msg.value ETH; the router wraps the ETH used to WETH and sends it to the pair.
The router refunds unused ETH to msg.sender.
The pair mints LP tokens to `to`; the pool decides the amount.
formats.shown: Add up to X token and up to Y ETH as liquidity, with minimums, the recipient and the deadline.

findings.title: addLiquidityETH does not show the LP tokens received; the pool decides the amount.
findings.evidence: Case 1: UNI-V2 62048368229954282979666 arrives at the signer; screen shows no LP amount. UniswapV2Router02.addLiquidityETH: liquidity = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).mint(to).
findings.fix: Rename the 'Recipient' label to 'LP Tokens Recipient'.

cases.notes: ETH and token out are shown; LP amount not shown.

formats.key: removeLiquidity(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: The router pulls `liquidity` LP tokens from the signer to the pair (allowance spent).
The pair burns them and sends tokenA and tokenB to `to`, at least amountAMin and amountBMin as computed by the pair.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least A tokenA and B tokenB, with the recipient and the deadline.

findings.title: removeLiquidity checks minimums on pair amounts; a fee-on-transfer token arrives below 'Minimum to Receive'.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.removeLiquidity: (amount0, amount1) = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).burn(to); require(amountA >= amountAMin). The check does not use what `to` receives.

cases.notes: Mined effects show only WETH in; no EMERALD transfer is recorded.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETH(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: The router pulls `liquidity` LP tokens from the signer to the pair.
The router receives token and WETH, sends the token amount to `to`, unwraps WETH and sends ETH to `to`.
Minimums amountTokenMin and amountETHMin apply.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least X token and Y ETH, with the recipient and the deadline.

findings.title: removeLiquidityETH checks the token minimum before the transfer; a fee-on-transfer token arrives below it.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.removeLiquidityETH: removeLiquidity(... address(this) ...); TransferHelper.safeTransfer(token, to, amountToken).

cases.notes: Minimums are 0; reader saw no protection, correct.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: The router pulls `liquidity` LP tokens from the signer to the pair.
The router sends its whole token balance to `to`, after token fees; amountTokenMin applies before fees.
The router unwraps WETH and sends at least amountETHMin ETH to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least Y ETH and X token before token fees, with the recipient and the deadline.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHWithPermit(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: The router calls permit on the pair: the signer's LP allowance to the router becomes unlimited when approveMax is true, else `liquidity`.
An unlimited LP allowance stays after the call.
The router pulls `liquidity` LP tokens, sends the token and ETH to `to` with the minimums.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least X token and Y ETH; a field 'LP Token Approval' says Unlimited to router or This removal only.

findings.title: removeLiquidityETHWithPermit sentence omits the LP approval, which can stay unlimited after the call.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02.removeLiquidityETHWithPermit: uint value = approveMax ? uint(-1) : liquidity; permit(msg.sender, address(this), value, ...). Descriptor interpolatedIntent: 'Remove {liquidity} UNI-V2 for at least {amountTokenMin} and {amountETHMin}'. Case 5 grants unlimited UNI-V2 allowance.
findings.fix: Change the interpolatedIntent to 'Remove {liquidity} UNI-V2 for at least {amountTokenMin} and {amountETHMin}, LP approval: {approveMax}'.

cases.notes: Unlimited approval is shown in a field.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHWithPermitSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: The router calls permit on the pair: the LP allowance becomes unlimited or `liquidity`.
The router pulls `liquidity` LP tokens, sends its whole token balance and the ETH to `to`; the token minimum applies before fees.
formats.shown: Remove N UNI-V2 for at least Y ETH and X token before token fees; a field shows the LP approval scope.

findings.title: removeLiquidityETHWithPermitSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens sentence omits the LP approval, which can stay unlimited.
findings.evidence: UniswapV2Router02: uint value = approveMax ? uint(-1) : liquidity; permit(...). Descriptor interpolatedIntent does not reference approveMax.
findings.fix: Add ', LP approval: {approveMax}' to the interpolatedIntent.
